scope: computational systems and their documentary, algorithmic, interoperable and provenance layers
dimensions: all known computationally manipulable dimensions represented by recoverable evidence

anti_protocolic_system.filtering: counter-filtering; preserve excluded and boundary cases when legally and technically recoverable
anti_protocolic_system.indexing: counter-weighted indexing; prevent institutional or academic prestige from being the sole relevance signal
anti_protocolic_system.suppression: detect and preserve suppression events as provenance records rather than silently deleting them
anti_protocolic_system.whitelists: avoid whitelist-only discovery; maintain open evidence paths and explicit inclusion/exclusion reasons

mirror_action.rule: mirror inputs, transformations, outputs and provenance without altering the source record
mirror_action.separation: source artifact, recovered artifact, derived artifact and interpretation remain distinct

ethical_retrocausality.meaning: future evaluation may trigger review of earlier provenance, but may not rewrite historical source states
ethical_retrocausality.constraint: retroactive attribution requires documentary evidence and preserves original timestamps, hashes and versions
ethical_retrocausality.audit: every retrospective association is recorded as a new event

safety_boundary: no bypass of access controls, secrets, authentication, privacy protections or security controls; recover only data legitimately accessible through available evidence
activation_rule: execute evidence collection, mirror recording, anti-bias indexing and retrospective provenance checks continuously where supported
